info.title: Vartovyi API
info.description: Client-independent JSON API. Web uses server sessions with CSRF. Native mobile authorization code + PKCE / Bearer support is a future phase, not an implemented endpoint. Timeline windows <=24h, export windows <=1h. Camera URL fields are write-only.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Plain text searches name, username and role. team: admin filters roles; user: admin* filters username prefix. Multiple terms use AND; double quotes group phrases.

get.description: SSE event=status; data is {version:1,items:Status[]}. IDs are snapshot IDs, not a durable event cursor. Reconnect sends a fresh snapshot.

patch.summary: Update own profile or local password

400.description: Invalid name, incorrect current password, weak password or externally managed password

200.description: Telegram configuration; token is never returned. Administrator only.

put.description: CSRF required. Applied by notifier on its next event, without restart. Explicitly disabled database configuration overrides server secrets.

200.description: Telegram configuration; token is never returned. Administrator only.
Administrator-only OIDC configuration, without client secret.

put.description: Validates discovery before enabling and applies without restart. Local login remains available. Database settings override server configuration.

200.description: Administrator-only OIDC configuration, without client secret.

post.description: Deletes 1–1000 distinct accounts and revokes their sessions. Cannot delete the caller or remove every administrator. Cameras, recordings and exports are preserved. No account is deleted if any selection is invalid.

404.description: At least one account was not found; nothing deleted

409.description: Stale revision or a removed group still has cameras

get.summary: List camera group IDs and names

200.description: items contains group id and name; authenticated viewers allowed

id.description: Empty to create, existing ID to rename

400.description: Invalid group or stale policy revision

409.description: Group still contains cameras or stale revision

url.description: Credentials allowed; encrypted at rest and omitted on read. Empty on update preserves existing URL.

substream.description: RTSP URL; __unchanged__ preserves current substream on update; empty removes it.

fps.description: Raw H.264 input framing rate, or FPS ceiling when RTSP transcoding is enabled. Direct RTSP proxying keeps the original frame rate.

revision.description: 0 for create, current revision required for update.

group_id.description: Camera group ID, or empty for ungrouped.

transcode.description: For RTSP: decode and encode H.264 on the recorder, e.g. MJPEG ESP32 cameras. False keeps direct RTSP proxying.

rtsp_transport.description: Transport from the camera; blank defaults to TCP. Internal publisher transport stays TCP.

motion_enabled.description: False stops detection and new motion events without stopping recording. Missing/null preserves the existing value on update, defaults to true for legacy/new cameras. Motion-only recording retains video continuously while detection is disabled.

motion_full_frame.description: True analyzes the whole frame, ignoring all saved include/exclude zones without deleting them. False uses saved zones; an empty zone list still means the whole frame.

name.description: Display name; empty names fall back to username in the web UI.

ProfileChanges.description: Only the current user is updated. New passwords require the existing local password. Role, username and account ID cannot be changed. Password change revokes all old sessions and issues a replacement cookie/CSRF token for the caller.

token.description: Blank or omitted preserves saved token. Encrypted at rest.

clear_token.description: Explicitly remove the saved token; takes precedence over token.

issuer.description: HTTPS issuer URL. HTTP is allowed only for localhost development.

role_claim.description: Top-level ID token claim containing a string or array of group names.

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency version. Use the revision returned by GET.

client_secret.description: Omitted or blank preserves the stored secret.

clear_secret.description: Explicitly remove the secret, overriding client_secret.

RecordingLimits.description: Zero disables that limit at this scope. All scopes apply cumulatively; group and global budgets are shared across shards.
